rule_description: Winsorize or robust-clip extreme values at each timestamp cross-sectionally
allowed_inputs: Factor raw values at each timestamp
implementation_notes: Use median-based robust clipping (e.g. 1st/99th percentile or MAD-based); per-timestamp cross-sectional only

rule_description: Standardize each factor cross-sectionally at each timestamp before combining
implementation_notes: Standard z-score or rank-normalization within each timestamp; no fitting to future data

rule_description: Adjust factor sign to match expected_direction from factor catalog (negative=short signal; positive=long signal)
allowed_inputs: Standardized factor values; expected_direction from catalog
forbidden_inputs: Realized returns used to infer direction; forward returns
implementation_notes: Expected direction is theory-based only; never inferred from realized performance

rule_description: For conditional-direction factors (range_1h; range_4h; price_pos_24h; xs_rank_vol): document hypothesis explicitly; do not infer direction from realized returns
forbidden_inputs: Forward returns; labels; return-based direction inference
implementation_notes: Must record which hypothesis is used for conditional factors in implementation notes

rule_description: range_1h; range_4h; and price_pos_24h must not be used as standalone direct alpha; they are capped exposure-intensity modifiers; direction/hypothesis must be documented before implementation; do not infer position overlay direction from realized returns
allowed_inputs: Range and price position factor values
forbidden_inputs: Forward returns; labels; return-based direction inference; standalone alpha use
implementation_notes: Cap multiplier range (e.g. 0.8 to 1.2) to prevent overlay from dominating core signal; document hypothesis for each conditional factor

rule_description: xs_rank_vol modifies confidence / implementation quality; it does not flip signal sign; it should be capped to avoid excessive exposure scaling
forbidden_inputs: Forward returns; alpha signals derived from volume alone; sign-flipping logic
implementation_notes: Cap gate range (e.g. 0.5 to 1.0) to prevent extreme scaling; low liquidity = lower conviction not reversal

rule_description: final_score = raw_core_score x liquidity_gate x position_overlay_multiplier; raw_core_score = 60% risk_pressure_component + 40% oscillator_exhaustion_component; design only; no signal values computed in 9A-R2; no backtest
forbidden_inputs: Forward returns; labels; optimization; backtest outputs
implementation_notes: Multiplicative structure; all modifiers capped; design specification only; no computation in 9A-R or 9A-R2

rule_description: If a factor value is missing for a symbol at a timestamp: exclude that symbol from the cross-sectional score for that timestamp; do not impute
forbidden_inputs: Forward fill from future; mean imputation; zero imputation
implementation_notes: NaN propagation is preferred over imputation; partial scores allowed per timestamp

rule_description: Dynamic universe remains diagnostic and not true PIT; results may overstate live performance; treat all Phase 9 outputs as diagnostic only
forbidden_inputs: Claims of live-ready or PIT-correct results
implementation_notes: Mark all Phase 9 outputs as diagnostic; survivorship bias caveat applies
